label: XG-PON1 OLT N2b boosted port (ODN class N2), 16 ports
notes: The boosted XG-PON port, per ITU-T G.987.2 (02/2023) Amd. 1 (06/2023). Table 9-3's ODN Class header prints two rows over the same six columns - N1 | N2 | N2 | E1 | E2 | E2 and then N2a | N2b | E2a | E2b - so N2b is a power-budget column INSIDE ODN class N2 (16-31 dB, clause 6.1 / Table 6-1), not a fifth class; that is why this row's class is N2 and its budgetDb is the N2 31 dB. Table 9-3 gives mean launched power +10.5..+12.5 dBm for N2b, and Table 9-4 has only the four class columns, so the card's receiver is N2's -29.5 dBm sensitivity / -9.0 dBm overload and the ONU upstream launch stays the single +2.0..+7.0 dBm range every XG-PON class prints. What the port buys is the cheaper ONU receiver, not reach: pair it with xg-pon-ont-n2b-1xge (-21.5 dBm) and 10.5 - (-21.5) = 32.0 dB downstream against the 31 dB class, the same 1 dB of slack every other row here carries (measured: a 21.52 dB ODN reads 10.48 dB of headroom and 9.48 dB of class headroom, identical to N2a plus the -28 dBm ONT). Pair it with the -28 dBm ONT instead and the arithmetic reads 12.5 - (-28) = 40.5 dB, but the class verdict still stops at 31 - the extra launch is not extra reach, it is what the manufacturer paid for the reduced-sensitivity receiver, so do not read a green budget on that pairing as a longer PON. The ceiling is also the overload trap: 12.5 - (-3.5) = 16.0 dB, exactly N2's published minimum ODN loss, so any span shorter than 16 dB of loss overdrives the far end and needs the pad the budget names, sized at the top of the launch window (measured: a 100 m patch asks for 16 dB). Caveats that travel with the figures: the downstream sensitivity and overload are at the 10^-3 BER reference level (Table 9-3, Note 4 -> G-Sup.39 clause 9.4.1) and the upstream at 10^-4 (Table 9-4, Note 6), both pre-FEC operating points, and Note 5 requires the ONU figure in the presence of G-PON and video overlay on the same ODN. Ports 16 and the 1:64 split are line-card sizes, not standards figures - confirm the card's own limit. This row is a column of the class, so the palette subtitle reads 'xg-pon N2' for both N2 columns; the label carries the b. Class figures from the recommendation, not one measured card: replace with the line card actually purchased before construction.
